note: Ps50 God-the-Judge (corrected method). Human IB: chasid faithful; true worship (todah thanksgiving x2, qara call-upon, kabed glorify x2) vs empty sacrifice; the wicked's inner corruption (sane hate musar discipline, ratsah pleased-with-thief, adultery, ra evil-speech + mirmah deceit, shakach forget God, bin Mark/consider). God-acts (summons/calls/righteousness/knows/delivers/silent/salvation) = qualifiers; cosmic/ritual = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: summoned by God who comes to judge (v1,3-4)

'Gather to me my FAITHFUL ONES (chasidim), who made a covenant with me by sacrifice!' — the covenant-loyal summoned before the Judge; chasid (recurs Ps30,31,37) the godly whom God gathers (his summoning/coming = qualifier), the true worshippers distinguished from the wicked (v16)
the God who owns all and needs nothing (v10-12)

'Offer to God a sacrifice of THANKSGIVING (todah)' — the worship God actually desires, not slaughtered bulls; todah (recurs Ps26:7, 42:4) the grateful heart's offering, since God owns all and is not hungry (his knowing/owning all = the qualifier) — thankfulness, not ritual, honours him

'and CALL (qara) upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me' — the true worship of dependent prayer; qara here the calling that God answers with deliverance (the qualifier), issuing in glorifying him — the cycle of trust, rescue, and praise
the fruit of calling and deliverance

'and you shall GLORIFY (kabed) me' — the honour rendered God for deliverance; kabed here the glorifying that answers rescue, the response God seeks (echoed v23: 'the one who offers thanksgiving glorifies me')

'But to the WICKED (rasha) God says: What right have you to recite my statutes?' — the hypocrite who mouths God's covenant while living in sin; rasha here the one whose reciting of the law is condemned by his conduct — religion without obedience
paired with casting God's words behind him

'For you HATE (sane) discipline, and you cast my words behind you' — the wicked's aversion to correction; sane here the hatred of instruction (contrast the righteous hatred of evil, Ps45:7) — rejecting God's discipline and flinging his words away
the object of the wicked's hatred
'you hate DISCIPLINE (musar)' — the correction the wicked refuses; musar = instruction/chastening, the very thing the wise love (Prov) and the wicked spurn, casting God's words behind them
be pleased with / consent (ratsah - the thief)
paired with keeping company with adulterers

'If you see a thief, you are PLEASED (ratsah) with him' — inner complicity with evil; ratsah here the approving delight in the thief (contrast approving God's ways) — the heart consenting to wickedness, keeping company with adulterers

'and you keep company with ADULTERERS (naaph)' — the wicked's fellowship with the immoral; naaph the adulterers whose lot he shares, delighting in thieves and consorting with the unfaithful — corruption by association
paired with the tongue framing deceit
'You give your mouth free rein for EVIL (ra)' — unbridled wicked speech; ra here the evil the mouth pours out, the tongue set loose for harm, framing deceit against brother and kin
paired with the mouth given to evil
'and your tongue frames DECEIT (mirmah)' — the tongue harnessed to lies; mirmah (recurs widely) the deceit the wicked's tongue weaves, slandering his brother and mother's son (v20)

'MARK this (bin — consider), then, you who forget God' — the summons to discern before judgement; bin here the considering the God-forgetters are called to, lest God tear them apart with none to deliver
emboldened by God's silence at their sin (v21)

'you who FORGET (shakach) God' — the root of the wicked's sin, forgetting God; shakach here the God-forgetfulness (emboldened by his silence, v21 = the qualifier — 'you thought I was one like yourself'), the deadly presumption that draws the warning

'The one who offers THANKSGIVING (todah) as his sacrifice glorifies me' — the psalm's conclusion: gratitude is the true sacrifice; todah (recurs v14) the thankful offering that honours God, over against the empty ritual of the wicked
issues in God showing his salvation (v23)

'offers thanksgiving... GLORIFIES (kabed) me; to one who orders his way rightly I will show the salvation of God' — the thankful, right-ordered life that honours God and receives his salvation; kabed (recurs v15) the glorifying that is the true worship, rewarded with God's deliverance (the qualifier)
summon / call (qara - God summons the earth)
God's summoning that gathers the faithful (v1->v5)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'God the LORD speaks and SUMMONS (qara) the earth' - God's summoning is not a human IB char; the divine call that gathers the faithful to judgement (279604). Qualifier.
be silent (charash - God does not, negated)
God coming, not silent, to gather+judge (v3->v5)
v3 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): 'Our God comes; he does not KEEP SILENCE (charash)' - God's coming/speaking is not a human IB char; the advent that gathers the faithful (279604). Qualifier.
call (qara - God calls heaven and earth)
God's calling the cosmos as witnesses to judge his people (v4->v5)

v4 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'He CALLS (qara) to the heavens above and to the earth, that he may judge his people' - God's summoning the cosmos as witnesses is not a human IB char; part of the judgement-scene gathering the faithful (279604). Qualifier.
God's righteousness, ground of the judgement the faithful gather to (v6)

v6 QUALIFIER (God's righteousness): 'The heavens declare his RIGHTEOUSNESS (tsedeq), for God himself is judge!' - God's righteousness is not a human IB char; the just character behind the judgement (279604). Qualifier.
know (yada - God knows all the birds)
God's ownership/self-sufficiency grounding true worship as thanksgiving (v10-12->v14)

v11 QUALIFIER (God's knowledge/ownership): 'I KNOW (yada) all the birds of the hills, and all that moves is mine' - God's knowing and owning all is not a human IB char; the truth (he needs no sacrifice) that grounds thanksgiving as the true worship (279514). Qualifier.
God's deliverance answering the human call (v15)
v15 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'call upon me... I will DELIVER (chalats) you' - God's rescue is not a human IB char; the answer to the worshipper's calling (279519). Qualifier.
be silent / hold peace (charash - God's, past)
God's past silence that emboldened the wicked's forgetting (v21->v22)

v21 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'These things you have done, and I have been SILENT (charash); you thought I was one like yourself' - God's forbearing silence is not a human IB char; the divine restraint the wicked misread, deepening their God-forgetting (279570). Qualifier.
salvation (yesha - I will show the salvation of God)
the salvation God shows the one who glorifies him (v23)

v23 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'to one who orders his way rightly I will show the SALVATION (yesha) of God' - God's salvation is not a human IB char; the reward shown the thankful, right-ordered worshipper (279578). Qualifier.
v3: 'before him a devouring fire, around him a mighty TEMPEST (saar)' - the storm accompanying God's theophany; a cosmic phenomenon, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v5: 'who made a COVENANT (berit) with me by sacrifice' - the covenant bond the faithful entered; the object of their loyalty (279604), a relationship/institution, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v6: 'The heavens DECLARE (nagad) his righteousness' - the cosmos testifying to God's justice; the heavens' proclamation (cf Ps19:1), not a human inner operation. Standalone.
v7: 'HEAR (shama), O my people, and I will speak' - God's summons to his people to listen to his testimony; the call to hear preceding the indictment. Standalone.
be hungry (raab - if I were hungry)

v12: 'If I were HUNGRY (raab), I would not tell you, for the world is mine' - God's (hypothetical) hunger, denied; a rhetorical figure of God's self-sufficiency, not a human inner operation. Standalone.

v13: 'Do I eat the FLESH (basar) of bulls or drink the blood of goats?' - the sacrificial flesh God does not consume; a rhetorical object showing God needs no offerings, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v14: 'and PERFORM (shalam) your vows to the Most High' - the paying of vows, a religious duty paired with the thank-offering (279514); an act of worship, captured alongside thanksgiving. Standalone.
v16: 'or take my COVENANT (berit) on your lips' - the covenant the hypocrite mouths without keeping; the object of his empty recitation, not an inner operation. Standalone.
deliver / rescue (natsal - none to deliver, negated)

v22: 'lest I tear you apart, and there be none to DELIVER (natsal)!' - the absence of any rescuer from God's judgement; the deliverance that will not come for the God-forgetter, not a human inner operation. Standalone.
